change_summary: Normal MCP tool results carry live server identity and explicit client freshness in text and structured content. Stable notices distinguish unknown/current/compatible/unsupported, source-owned update and Host-reported acknowledgment. Content-free per-binding observations reuse identical states for 24 hours; new sessions verify loaded guidance. Candidate only; publication and customer UI acceptance remain separate.

canonical_skill.note: First-use consumes normal result facts or one exact-fact check. Current is quiet; unknown interrupts only material work; install and new-session loading remain distinct.

server_contract.note: Normal text/structured facts, optional namespaced reports and notice acknowledgment; explicit unsupported facts fail closed before business execution. Current/compatible/unknown retain OAuth, scopes and business owners; default-full unchanged.

package_manifests.note: Candidate version 1.7.102/contract 2026-10-25.1. Compatibility minimum/family unchanged; protected immutable release and remote version/hash readback remain pending.

workspace_cli.note: No CLI source/version change. Shared family and minimum revision remain; this candidate changes MCP/Skill instruction and response projections only.

help_center.note: Existing localized Help source actions remain compatible. Source-aware normal-use lifecycle is updated in the distribution runbook; no duplicate updater or claims of marketplace auto-update.

package_setup.note: Static hook consumes stable notice identity and separates source update from session activation; no installer/network action.

harness_and_mainline.note: Historical source and first-use experience preserved, with native trace/result/installed-source boundaries and primary-source comparison.

external_marketplaces.note: Protected release and fresh Marketplace discovery pending; no deployed or publicly installable claim.

public_release_assets.note: Same builder, version and checksums for public Skill/Plugin mirrors. Candidate 1.7.102; actual protected publication/readback pending.

release_evidence.note: Real SQL/native Host and cleanup evidence, separately scoped from production/UI/marketplace acceptance.
